summary: Tantech Holdings filed a Form 6-K disclosing board changes effective August 2, 2026. Directors Weilin Zhang and independent director Hongdao Qian resigned without disagreement; replacements were elected by remaining board members. Yongxin Su became director and Co-CEO (Class III, term to 2027 AGM); Bihua Liu became director and Co-CFO (filling Zhang's vacancy); Lei Yao became independent director and nominating committee chair (filling Qian's vacancy, independence determined under Nasdaq Rule 5605(a)(2)); Shipu Huang became independent director (Class I, term to 2028 AGM). The event is a routine board succession, not a forced departure. Watch for whether new management signals strategic shifts at future shareholder meetings.
